description: This file defines the TimeReportDataAPI class which extends ReportDataAPI to provide an endpoint for retrieving time report data via a REST API. It specifies API parameters, response schema, and includes logic for obtaining the appropriate report class based on report name.

classes.name: TimeReportDataAPI
classes.description: A REST API class that provides endpoints for fetching time report data, extending the generic ReportDataAPI and implementing a method to retrieve specific report instances based on request parameters.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to determine the report type based on the report name parameter, throws BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
